title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: End of Day, August 28, 2026, with Pre-market Outlook for August 29, 2026

items.headline: Markets Closed Slightly Lower Friday, Awaiting Key Economic Data Today
items.summary: U.S. stock markets ended Friday, August 28, with slight declines across major indices, influenced by Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish remarks at the Jackson Hole Symposium. All eyes are now on upcoming economic data, particularly the U.S. Core PCE, as markets remain in pre-market ahead of today's open, August 29.

items.headline: Okta Surges on Strong Performance
items.summary: Cloud software provider Okta Inc. ($OKTA) was among the strongest performers, seeing a notable increase.

items.headline: Salesforce Jumps on Earnings Beat
items.summary: Salesforce Inc. ($CRM) rallied after reporting blowout Q2 earnings and revenue, along with raised fiscal year guidance.

items.headline: Elastic Shares Soar Post-Earnings
items.summary: Elastic N.V. ($ESTC) saw its shares soar amid heavy trading after the company reported higher fiscal Q1 non-GAAP earnings and revenue.

items.headline: Build-A-Bear Workshop Declines
items.summary: Build-A-Bear Workshop Inc. ($BBW) was among the weakest stocks, experiencing a significant decline.

items.headline: Dick's Sporting Goods Experiences Sharp Fall
items.summary: Dick's Sporting Goods Inc. ($DKS) was one of the worst-performing stocks of the week.

items.headline: Marvell Technology Slips on Revenue Doubts
items.summary: Marvell Technology Inc. ($MRVL) lost ground due to doubts surrounding the timing of revenue from its AI chip agreement with Alphabet's Google.

items.headline: Fed Chair Warsh Reaffirms Inflation Fight at Jackson Hole
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh delivered hawkish remarks at the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium, emphasizing the central bank's commitment to achieving its 2% inflation goal and indicating that recent inflation data does not suggest a significant shift in trend. This led to increased market speculation for a potential September rate hike.

items.headline: Strong Tech Earnings Continue to Drive Market Optimism
items.summary: Despite Friday's overall market dip, strong earnings reports from major technology companies, including NVIDIA ($NVDA) earlier in the week and Salesforce ($CRM) and CrowdStrike ($CRWD) on Friday, continued to fuel market optimism, particularly in the semiconductor and software sectors.

items.headline: U.S. Core PCE Awaited Today
items.summary: Markets are keenly awaiting the release of the U.S. Core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index data later today, August 29, following the ongoing Jackson Hole Symposium. This key inflation metric will be closely watched for its implications on future Federal Reserve policy.

items.headline: Technology and Communication Services Led Gains for the Week
items.summary: For the week ending August 28, the technology and communication services sectors were top performers, despite some profit-taking on Friday. Consumer Discretionary also showed relative strength. Conversely, industrials, healthcare, and energy were among the lagging sectors over the week.
